note: Both sets contain duplicate claims for KP, KI, KD and the damping ratio, but Set B's duplicates consistently bind the values to the baseline blade-pitch controller as stated in the text and figure caption. Set B also keeps the meaningful condition that ζφ = 0.7 is the upper limit of the recommended range used to compensate for neglecting negative damping from the generator-torque controller. Set A instead has one claim whose 'condition' is merely the symbol zeta_phi, which is vague and adds nothing, and it omits the compensating rationale. Otherwise the numeric values and quotes are identical and correct in both sets.
